# Nova Tech

> Technology for the way you live.

Nova Tech is a fictional technology retailer landing page created as a frontend development portfolio project. It showcases smartphones, laptops, tablets, audio devices, wearables, and accessories through a modern retail experience.

## Products

- [Featured Products](/#featured): Explore selected Nova Tech devices and technology products.
- [Product Categories](/#categories): Browse smartphones, laptops, tablets, audio, wearables, and accessories.
- [Deals](/#promotion): View current promotions and selected technology offers.

## Store

- [Visit Nova Tech](/#store): Store location, opening hours, and contact information.
- [FAQ](/#faq): Frequently asked questions about products, shopping, and support.

## Brand

Nova Tech focuses on thoughtfully selected technology designed for work, creativity, entertainment, and everyday life.

## Project

This is a fictional portfolio project created to demonstrate frontend development, responsive design, UI/UX, accessibility, and performance optimization.
